questions.question: What is the core freshness invariant for an admitted live-video frame?
options: It produces a decision within the deadline or follows an explicit drop, defer, or fallback policy
It must always wait in an unbounded FIFO queue
It must use the largest available model
It must be retained forever
questions.explanation: A bounded, explicit outcome prevents overload from silently turning current observations into stale decisions.

questions.question: What is the core end-to-end invariant of the lesson?
options: Keep input identity, representation version, model version, and decision policy connected to the outcome
Always use the largest available language model
Normalize every language with one universal rule
Return a model score without product policy
questions.explanation: A production decision is reproducible only when its input and every compatible transformation and policy version remain connected.

questions.question: Why do large recommenders retrieve candidates before applying a rich ranker?
options: Scoring the entire catalog with expensive features and models would exceed the request budget
Retrieval guarantees causal evaluation
Ranking models cannot consume embeddings
Candidate retrieval removes every cold start
questions.explanation: Cheap retrieval narrows millions of items to a feasible set. A richer model can then spend its latency budget where it matters.

questions.question: A relevant document is absent from every retriever's candidate set. What can the reranker do?
options: Recover it from the full corpus automatically
Reorder only the candidates it received, so it cannot recover the document
Bypass hard authorization filters
Reduce indexing lag
questions.explanation: Ranking cannot recover a missing candidate. Diagnose retrieval recall, filters, tokenization, embeddings, ANN settings, or candidate depth.

questions.question: What distinguishes a multimodal system from an API that merely accepts several file types?
options: It defines how evidence is aligned, fused, and handled when a modality is missing or contradictory
It always converts every input into plain text before inference
It requires every modality to have the same number of tokens
It guarantees that adding a modality improves accuracy
questions.explanation: The system contract includes alignment, fusion, contribution, trust, and degraded-input behavior; multiple upload fields alone do not provide those guarantees.
